content: However, when observing gender differences across shows, no clear trend can be identified, as shown in Figure FIGREF21. For shows like Africa1 Infos or La Place du Village, we find an average WER lower for women than for men, while the trend is reversed for shows such as Un Temps de Pauchon or Le Masque et la Plume. The disparity of the results depending on the show leads us to believe that other factors may be entangled within the observed phenomenon.
